text:
Alex G: Quick check — scheduling a heterogeneous throughput run tonight to exercise continuous-batching knobs across mixed short and long inputs. Goal: characterize throughput and tail latency for mixed workloads and produce a recommended default. ETA ~01:00 UTC. @Maria L @Ryan T can you confirm the sample sets and the probe knobs?

Maria L: Roger. I'll upload a seeded mix (mix-80-20-short-long.json) to /datasets/cb/samples by 23:00. It contains extremes: tiny prompts (1 token) and long tails (~4k). Also added a small eval set for quality regressions.

Ryan T: Heads-up — if we keep max_tokens=4096 KV cache memory grows a lot on smaller nodes. Plan: run both max_tokens=2048 and 4096, plus a "no-prefix-cache" baseline to see perf delta.

Priya S: I can add a runtime flag to disable prefix KV caching per-worker. Will open a small PR to cb-disable-cache branch, should be quick.

Alex G: Test matrix I'm planning: [max_batch: 16, 32, 64] x [queue_window_ms: 5, 20, 50] x [max_tokens: 2048, 4096] x [cache: on/off]. Each config 10m steady-state. Tag runs with cb-hetero-2026-03-17. perf-bot — can you auto-collect token breakdown, p95/p99 latency, and per-node memory?

perf-bot: yes — will collect per-route token counts, p50/p95/p99 latencies, CPU/mem snapshots, and throughput. Artifacts will be uploaded to s3 with the run tag.

Alex G: Loadgen command we plan to use (small ramp and rampdown):
```bash
./loadgen --profile mixed --dataset s3://redwood/cb/mix-80-20-short-long.json --rps 1200 --duration 600 --tag cb-hetero-2026-03-17
```

Ryan T: For safety add --max-concurrent=200 to limit in-flight requests on smaller nodes, else we'll see OOM. Also recommend monitoring queue-length metric on the router.

Maria L: Uploaded datasets and prompt truncation rules to the bucket. I also added a README describing how the short/long split was sampled.

Priya S: PR pushed: cb-disable-cache. CI passed on staging. Please schedule a canary deploy before running the full matrix.

Alex G: Scheduling canary on cluster cb-stage-2 at 23:30 UTC now, will run the smallest matrix first (max_batch=16, queue_window=5, max_tokens=2048, cache=on). Ping here if you see anomalies.

ci-bot: deploy cb-disable-cache to cb-stage-2 at 23:30 UTC scheduled.

perf-bot: First canary run finished (max_batch=16, queue_window=5, max_tokens=2048, cache=on). Summary: throughput ~42k tok/s, p95 latency 180ms, p99 410ms, avg CPU 74%, tail memory 68%. Artifacts: s3://redwood/results/cb-hetero-2026-03-17/run1.tar.gz

Ryan T: Noticed ~8% increase in queued requests when queue_window=50ms for mixed long sequences. For long-heavy requests we might need to cap max_batch lower or add a max_tokens-per-batch heuristic.

Alex G: Good catch. After full sweep, can someone assemble a short PR with recommended defaults for mixed workloads? I can draft the text; Maria can add data.

Maria L: I'll start the draft PR with numbers and links to artifacts.

Alex G: Thanks all. I'll update the run-matrix doc with outcomes once the runs complete. :thumbsup:
